about.title: About Us
about.p1: A place in the Magic Forest where workshops, seminars, and camps for dogs and their owners take place.
about.p2: 3.5 hectares of fenced area - meadows, a pond, summer houses, and a hall in the very heart of the forest.
about.p3: An ideal place for dog lovers who want to develop their passions.
about.p4: A professional 2500m² training ground, sanitary facilities, kitchenette, and accommodation options - dedicate all your time to your passion.

descriptions.agility: Navigate obstacle courses with your dog at top speed. Build teamwork, precision, and confidence through dynamic agility training sessions.
descriptions.motivation: Unlock your dog's drive and enthusiasm. Learn reward-based techniques that strengthen the bond between handler and dog.
descriptions.dummy: Master retrieval and hunting-style exercises. Develop your dog's natural instincts through structured dummy training drills.
descriptions.frisbee: High-energy disc sport combining throws, catches, and freestyle routines. Perfect for active dogs who love to run and leap.
descriptions.obedience: Precision training for everyday manners and competitive obedience. From basics to advanced - build reliable, responsive communication.
descriptions.photography: Capture stunning portraits of your dog in a natural forest setting. Professional sessions with expert guidance on posing and lighting.
descriptions.mantrailing: Scent-tracking workshops where your dog follows a specific person's trail. Tap into their incredible nose and problem-solving abilities.
descriptions.communication: Understand your dog's body language and signals. Improve your daily interactions through science-based communication methods.
